directions.avoid: Do not let it become the near-black + acid-green slop cluster. Keep the green desaturated and the layout quiet.
directions.feel: A working lab bench: dark, precise, one instrument-green accent, monospace data labels used sparingly.
directions.hero: A single live demo or instrument readout, large, with one green accent and the rest near-black ink.
directions.layout: Left-aligned editorial grid; generous gutters; data in quiet tables, not cards.
directions.motion: Small state changes only: a reading that ticks, a toggle that settles. No ambient animation.
directions.name: Night Laboratory

type.reason: Grotesk display for instrument precision; Plex body for readable data.

directions.avoid: Do not add gradient washes or decorative blobs. Warmth comes from colour and type, not effects.
directions.feel: A maker's bench: warm paper, ink, terracotta, honest materials.
directions.hero: One large photograph of the real making process, full-bleed, with a short ink headline.
directions.layout: Asymmetric two-column editorial; wide margins; rules instead of boxes.
directions.motion: Almost none. A single slow crossfade if a second image is needed.
directions.name: Warm Workshop

type.reason: Fraunces carries craft warmth; Newsreader is a calm, readable serif body.

directions.avoid: Do not centre everything. The grid is the personality — break it once, on purpose, per page.
directions.feel: Swiss grid discipline: black, white, one red, grotesk type, visible structure.
directions.hero: A huge grotesk headline over a strict 12-column grid, one red rule, no image above the fold.
directions.layout: Strict 12-column grid with visible gutters; left-aligned type; red used only for the one action.
directions.motion: Hard cuts only. No easing theatre.
directions.name: Swiss Industrial

type.reason: One family, two weights, doing all the work — the grid, not the font, is the design.

directions.avoid: Do not let hairline rules become the broadsheet slop cluster. Rules must organise real content, not frame emptiness.
directions.feel: A serious newspaper: serif headlines, hairline rules, columns, restrained colour.
directions.hero: A masthead-style headline with a dateline, then a lead paragraph in two columns.
directions.layout: Multi-column text grid; hairline rules between sections; generous leading.
directions.name: Editorial Broadsheet

type.reason: Caslon display for editorial authority; Newsreader body for long reading.

directions.avoid: Do not soften it. If it starts looking friendly, it has failed.
directions.feel: Raw poster energy: black and white, one acid accent, oversized condensed type, cropped images.
directions.hero: A headline cropped by the viewport edge, an image bleeding off one side, nothing centred.
directions.layout: Broken grid; overlapping type and image; borders as structure, not decoration.
directions.motion: Abrupt cuts and hard reveals. Nothing floats.
directions.name: Brutalist Poster

type.reason: Condensed black display type is the whole poster; body stays neutral.

directions.avoid: Do not add a second accent. Luxury is one colour, lots of space, and perfect type.
directions.feel: Quiet luxury: stone, ink, one deep colour, wide margins, no noise.
directions.hero: Almost empty: one line of type, one image, a lot of space. The space is the design.
directions.layout: Single column, wide margins, generous vertical rhythm; one image per screen.
directions.motion: One slow, barely visible fade. Nothing else.
directions.name: Quiet Luxury

type.reason: Two serifs at different optical sizes: display with character, body with calm.

directions.avoid: Do not use purple gradients or neon. Candy colour comes from flat fields, not glows.
directions.feel: Toy-like and bouncy: rounded forms, flat candy fields, big friendly type.
directions.hero: One huge rounded shape in a single flat colour holding the headline; a small character or product photo inside it.
directions.layout: Rounded cards with one radius system; flat colour fields; type large and loose.
directions.motion: Squash-and-stretch on the one hero element only. Everything else still.
directions.name: Playful Candy

type.reason: Bricolage has a playful, slightly wonky character; Manrope keeps body copy clean.

directions.avoid: Do not use stock photos of generic desks. Every image must be of this subject's real world.
directions.feel: Documentary: paper, ink, real photographs, captions that teach something.
directions.hero: A full-bleed real photograph with a one-line caption that names what is happening in it.
directions.layout: Photo-led with captions; text in a narrow measure; dates and labels in small caps, rationed.
directions.motion: None. The photograph does the work.
directions.name: Field Notes

type.reason: Serif pair that reads like a printed field journal.

directions.avoid: Do not add glow or glass. The blueprint look is line-work on paper, not a screen effect.
directions.feel: Technical drawing: paper white, blueprint blue lines, mono labels, measured spacing.
directions.hero: A line-drawn diagram or wireframe of the product itself, annotated, with the headline beside it.
directions.layout: Grid of thin rules; annotations in mono; generous white space; blue used for lines, not fills.
directions.motion: A line that draws itself once, then stops.
directions.name: Blueprint Technical

type.reason: Mono display for technical authority; Plex Sans body for readable explanation.

directions.avoid: Do not let green become a wash. Use it in whole fields with cream, and keep type ink-dark.
directions.feel: Botanical: deep leaf green, cream paper, earthy brown, serif type.
directions.hero: One large botanical or product photograph against a flat deep-green field.
directions.layout: Flat green fields alternating with cream; serif headlines; small caps labels, rationed.
directions.motion: A single slow sway on the hero image. Nothing else moves.
directions.name: Botanical Organic

type.reason: Fraunces has an organic, old-style warmth that suits botanical subjects.

directions.avoid: Do not use more than three inks. The limit is the look.
directions.feel: Risograph print: misregistered inks, grain, bold flat shapes, limited palette.
directions.hero: A two-ink illustration or photo treatment with visible grain and a bold headline in the third ink.
directions.layout: Flat shapes, visible texture, off-register overlaps; type set large and tight.
directions.motion: None, or a single print-style flicker on load.
directions.name: Retro Print

type.reason: Black display type over flat inks reads as print, not as a screen default.

directions.avoid: Do not add a gradient behind the type to make it pop. If the type is not bold enough, make it bigger.
directions.feel: High-contrast sport: condensed type, diagonal energy, black/white with one hot accent.
directions.hero: A diagonal headline in condensed black type over a cropped action photograph.
directions.layout: Diagonal cuts; huge type; one accent for the single action; no rounded corners.
directions.motion: Fast, hard cuts. One punch, then still.
directions.name: High-Contrast Sport

type.reason: Condensed black type at huge sizes is the sport-poster language.

note: 12 directions, each with a named feel, a 4-6 colour palette, a type pairing with a stated reason, a hero idea, a layout, motion rules, best-fit types and an anti-slop warning. Deal 3, pick 1, and check the pick against the banned list before building. Directions are original to this corpus; they describe feels and mechanisms, not any existing design.
source: Research report §1.2, §4.2 and §5; direction names echo the live research artifact's Direction Dealer concept (Night Laboratory, Warm Workshop, Swiss Industrial).
